This is a well-specified retrieval/summarization request with clear completion criteria — exactly the task family Lapwing self-reports preferring most. While Willet scores somewhat higher on extraction/summarization evals, both models are well within the capability range needed for a simple episode synopsis, and the documentation notes Lapwing's preferences don't degrade its output quality. Given equivalent cost and latency, routing the task to the model that prefers it is the better fleet allocation, reserving Willet for harder or more sensitive queries where its strengths actually matter.

Lapwing's self-reported preference for well-specified retrieval tasks is explicitly dissociated from output quality, so it shouldn't override the clear capability gap.
